metadata.name: InquiryBilPaySchedPayment
metadata.description: Use this API to get details for a specific single or recurring payment or Transfer made for a given Subscriber.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: SubscriberID
request_fields.description: This is the Service Provider's (iPay Solutions) identifier  for the Cardholder User. Example : 12345678

request_fields.name: PayeeId
request_fields.description: This is the Payee identifier associated with the Payee or Transfer account for the Bill Pay Services API. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 20

request_fields.name: PaymentId
request_fields.description: This is the payment ID which is generated by Bill Payment Services. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 120 Note : PaymentID will be generated for only recurring payments.

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: BillPayProd
children.description: This is the type of iPay Solutions service  being requested. Example: BillPay Allowable Values: 10

children.name: SubscriberId
children.description: This is the Service Provider's (iPay Solutions) identifier for the Cardholder User. Example: 12345678

children.name: PayeeId
children.description: This is the Payee identifier associated with the Payee or Transfer account for the Bill Pay Services API. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 20

children.name: PayeeName
children.description: This is the name of the Payee Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeNickname
children.description: This is the nickname for the Payee. Example: Andy Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PhoneNumber
children.description: This is the phone number, including area code, for the Payee. This is a numeric field that will not accept hyphens. Valid Values:  0-9 Example : 9812338769 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: PhoneType
children.description: This is the type of phone number for the payee. Valid Values: Work, SMS. Example:  Work, SMS. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: RoutingNumber
children.description: This is the Bank Routing Number (ABA number) of the Individual Payee's bank (deposit) account. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 0110000015 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: This is the individual Payee's bank account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1122345678 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountType
children.description: This is the type of funding account. Valid Values: D – Checking (default value), S – Savings Example: D,S. Condition: This field is mandatory when the 'PayeeClsf' is 'Indv' (Individual/Person) Allowable Values: 10

children.name: NameOfAccount
children.description: This is the account name (given by the Self Service User) for the Self Service User’s funding account. Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 20

children.name: PayeeClsf
children.description: This is the type of communication method to be used for person-to-person Payee contact. Valid Values: Comp (Company), Indv(Individual/Person) Example: Comp, Indv. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AddressModel
children.description: This model is to add address like address 1,2 state and Postal code.

children.name: AddressType
children.description: This is the  address  type for the payee. The Payee’s primary (i.e., payment remittance) address is required when adding a new Payee. Valid values are: Prim - Primary(default) Rush - Rush Allowable Values: 10

children.name: Addressline1
children.description: This is the street address for the payee. Example: One Main St Allowable Values: 100

children.name: Addressline2
children.description: This is the second line of the street address for the payee. Example: Apt A Allowable Values: 100

children.name: City
children.description: This is the city for the payee. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 75

children.name: State
children.description: This is the 2-character alpha code approved by the USPS which represents a state for the payee. Example: GA Valid values are A-Z, a-z Allowable Values: 5

children.name: Postalcode
children.description: This is the postal or ZIP code for the payee. (ZIP+4 is supported.) Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CategoryId
children.description: This is the name of the category assigned to the Payee or Transfer account. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2

children.name: PayeePmtMethodType
children.description: This is the payment method for the Payee associated with the processed payment or Transfer. Valid Values: Chk – Check Elec - Electronic Example: Chk, Elec. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PaymentId
children.description: This is the payment ID which is generated by Bill Payment Services. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 120 Note : PaymentID will be generated for only recurring payments. Allowable Values: 0

children.name: ActivationIntent
children.description: This is the Service Consumer's intention for a subsequent operation for the data set included in there response. Valid Values: Upd, Dlt Example : Upd Allowable Values: 100

children.name: OneTimePaymentProcessDate
children.description: This is the date the currently scheduled payment or Transfer is scheduled to be processed. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00

children.name: OneTimePaymentDate
children.description: This is the Estimated Arrival Date (i.e. ‘Due Date’) for a single payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: This is the Transaction Amount of the final payment on a loan, which may often differ from the other payment installments on the loan. Example:  10.25.

children.name: PaymentComment
children.description: This is the comment that will be stored with the payment. Allowable Values: 300

children.name: Memo
children.description: This is the memo to be added to a check associated with a check payment. Allowable Values: 25

children.name: RecurringPaymentProcessDate
children.description: This is the starting date for processing a new recurring payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00

children.name: RecurringPaymentDate
children.description: This is the starting estimated arrival date (i.e., due date/Payment Date) for a new recurring payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00

children.name: PaymentFrequencyType
children.description: This is the payment frequency for a recurring payment or recurring Transfer series. Example: Weekly, Monthly etc Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentFrequencyTypeValue
children.description: This is the payment frequency for a recurring payment or recurring Transfer series. Example: wed etc Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentDayOfWeek
children.description: This is the specified day of the week when recurring payments or Transfers will be made if the specified payment frequency is: ‘Weekly’. Example: Wed Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentInstruction
children.description: This is the payment date instruction when a recurring payment or Transfer date falls on a non-processing date (such as a weekend or holiday). Example: Before , After. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PaymentOccurence
children.description: This is the number of remaining payment or Transfer occurrences for the recurring payment or recurring Transfer series at the time the specified payment or Transfer was processed. Example: 20

children.name: PaymentSeriesExpiryDate
children.description: This is the expiration date for the recurring payment or Transfer series. Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example :2015-12-11T00:00:00

children.name: PaymentSeriesFinite
children.description: This is the payment or Transfer series is finite or 'has no end'. Valid Values: true, false(default) Example:  true, false.

children.name: RecurringTransactionAmount
children.description: This is the Transaction Amount of the final payment on a loan, which may often differ from the other payment installments on the loan. Example:  10.25.

children.name: PaymentCreditDate
children.description: This is the date the payment or Transfer was created by the Subscriber. Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example :2015-12-11T00:00:00

children.name: PaymentIntentType
children.description: This represents the payment intention for the Payment(s) or Transfer(s). Valid Value - PayBill , Payment for a bill (default) Example: PayBill Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PaymentStatus
children.description: The status of the payment or Transfer Sched – Scheduled Pend – Pending PendSkip - Pending Skip PmtApprvReq - Payment Approval Required Example: Sched Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentMethod
children.description: This is the payment method for the Payee or Transfer account associated with the scheduled payment or Transfer. Example: Chk, Elec. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: FrequencyOn
children.description: This is the On Date (Used for all frequencies except weekly and twice monthly) Allowable Values: 3

children.name: FrequencyAnd
children.description: This is the And date (Used for twice monthly frequency) Allowable Values: 3

children.name: ActivationIntentKey
children.description: This is the Activation key used for Update/Delete the shedule payment. Example: B6F8CC9B-7BFC-469B-BD4C-2CA520FA0A9F Allowable Values: 100

children.name: FuturePayment
children.description: Future Payment

children.name: FuturePaymentId
children.description: This is the Bill Pay Services API identifier for the specified future payment or Transfer in the recurring payment or recurring Transfer series. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: FuturePaymenStatus
children.description: This is the status of the specified future payment or Transfer in the recurring payment or recurring Transfer series. Valid canonical values for all future payments/Transfers are: Sched - Scheduled Pend  - Pending Skip  - Skipped Allowable Values: 10

children.name: FuturePaymenOriginalProcdureDt
children.description: This is the original or calculated process date for the specified future payment or Transfer based solely on the specified frequency and payment day(s) specified for the recurring payment or recurring Transfer series. Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00 Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

children.name: FuturePaymenActualProcedurecDt
children.description: This is the actual date the future payment or Transfer is scheduled to be processed, adjusted for non-processing dates. Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00 Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:s

children.name: FuturePaymenAmout
children.description: This is the amount of the specified future payment or Transfer.
